Discover the world
around you.

LOKA connects you with the stories, people, and places hiding in plain sight — geo-tagged, shared, and alive.

Features

Everything you need to
explore, share, and discover.

Explore

Experience-driven exploration

Not just finding places — engaging with them. Discover cultural stories, hidden gems, and nature trails layered onto the world around you.

Discover

Every place has a story

Tap any tag to reveal what people have shared — photos, notes, context. From street food to local markets, LOKA surfaces the richness hiding in plain sight.

Map

See your world as a living map

Browse a real-time map of geo-tagged places near you — each pin a community contribution. Filter by type, recency, or topic to find exactly what you're looking for.

Contribute

Tag it, share it, build it together

Found something interesting? Take a picture, mark it on the map, and describe the place. Every tag you add becomes part of a living, shared knowledge base.

Who it's for

Made for everyone curious
about their world.

Whether you're a curious wanderer or a committed changemaker, LOKA meets you where you are.

Everyday Explorers

Discover hidden gems, cultural stories, and nature trails right in your backyard.

Institutions & Businesses

Enrich public spaces with augmented storytelling — museums, parks, and heritage sites come alive.

For Organisations

LOKA for your
Business Enterprise

The technology powering LOKA is a modular, AI-driven platform for location-specific data creation, categorisation, and discovery — built for scale, adaptability, and contextual depth.

Facility Mapping & Digital Twins

Map manufacturing units, campuses, or warehouse zones as layered, interactive spaces with markers, instructions, safety notes, and more.

Use case: A factory floor mapped with AR markers for equipment safety zones, maintenance logs, and real-time instructions.

AR-Powered Training Tools

Use LOKA's AR engine to create on-site training overlays — visual guides, SOPs, or safety walkthroughs that appear contextually in real space.

Use case: New staff navigate a retail outlet or service centre while receiving AR-based onboarding.

Internal Navigation & Micro-Mapping

Support employee movement across large campuses or complex environments with indoor/outdoor micro-maps, tagged checkpoints, and visual aids.

Use case: A hospital using tagged zones for orientation, emergencies, or equipment tracking.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

Empower teams to collaboratively tag and update spatial knowledge — replacing static manuals or maps with a living, visual database.

Use case: A construction firm enables engineers to annotate a site with phase-wise updates accessible via AR.
